The '''Attack on the Hutt Cartel listening post''' was a space battle engaged by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] to destroy a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] listening post, that was built within [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] near [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] with the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Cartels]] permission to intercept dispatches from nearby Imperial operations. To maintain their neutrality, the Hutt Cartel shared the schematics of the station with the Empire, resulting in the Sith dispatching a smalla fleet of [[Terminus-class destroyer|''Terminus''-class destroyers]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to destroy it. The [[Space station/Legends|station]] was defended by four defensive [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] emplacements and a small Republic fleet consisting of four [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvettes]] so Sith Command called for reinforcements, requesting any Sith forces in the areas. With these new fighters, and the elite [[Empire's Fury]] squadron, the Empire succeeded in accomplishing the mission and crippled both the Republic fleet and listening post.<ref name="Cartel Listening Post" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle appears as one of the space missions availble to Imperial players in the MMORPG [[Star Wars: The Old Republic]] and is part of the Mission [[Operation Echo Quake]], together with the [[Battle above Saleucami]]. The system in which this battle takes place in remains unnamed but the games galaxy map shows it to be very close to both [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] and Nar Shaddaa.
